suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on a Friday and didn't haunt me over the weekend.
I'm thankful for the mamak uncle who tops up my teh tarik without me even asking.
I'm grateful for finally finding the root cause of a bug instead of just patching around it and hoping.
I'm thankful for the five minutes before Subuh when the whole street is still asleep and it's just me and the kettle.
I'm grateful for a manager who actually reads the ticket before asking why something is taking so long.
I'm thankful for my dad calling just to ask if I've eaten, not because he needs anything from me.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm thankful for the rain that cools the car down before I even get in.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a paycheck that actually clears before rent is due this time.
I'm thankful for a group chat that still asks how I'm doing, not just when the next makan session is.
I'm grateful for a staging environment that actually caught the bug before it reached production.
I'm thankful for finding parking on the first try at the mall during Raya week.
I'm grateful for a long weekend that lined up with Maulidur Rasul so I could actually go back to my hometown.
I'm thankful for the office aircon finally getting fixed after three weeks of sweating through stand-ups.
I'm grateful for a teammate who said let's just ship it and iterate instead of debating the architecture for another hour.
